answer: The Elyms Limited Board "Android Dreams" is open until 2026-12-02 05:59 (UTC+8); it opened 2026-11-11 after maintenance. Its A-Class characters are Mint, Edgar and Adler. (Times follow the global site in UTC+8.)

"Blushing Mirage" (Shinku's limited S-Class Arc) comes from the "Resolve Special" Arc Research Program. Cost: Tri-Keys, or since Version 1.2 also the program's own Resolve Keys. Yes, it can still be obtained today (2026-11-18): it was rerun with Version 1.5 and is open (with Shinku's rerun Board "Before the Dawn") until 2026-12-02 05:59 (UTC+8); it needs the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop" completed. First run was 2026-07-08 to 2026-07-29 05:59.

Chaos's Limited Board was "Forsaken Path". It ran two weeks (not the usual three): 2026-06-24 after maintenance to 2026-07-08 05:59 (UTC+8). Chaos's Arc program (Pursuit Special) had no own Keys in its one run. Only one run, no rerun listed.

No. Roll counts are kept per Board name, so rolls on Zankou's "Alluring Shadows" (Alluring Perks) do not count toward Nanally's rerun Board "The Ichi-daime" (Tiger Perks), though both ran 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-09 05:59 (UTC+8). Perks are at 50, 120 and 200 total rolls of that same Board name (progress returns when the same-named Board is rerun).

Launch: 2026-04-29, 11:00 (UTC+8). Platforms at launch: Windows PC (official launcher), iOS, Android, Mac, Google Play PC, PlayStation 5/5 Pro; Steam, Epic Games Store and Samsung Galaxy Store were announced 2026-07-08. No: progress is not shared between servers (Asia, America, Europe, SEA are independent); it is shared across platforms only on the same server with the same login account.

The S-Class Standard Character Selection Box lets you pick one of Sakiri, Baicang, Hathor, Fadia, Daffodill or Jiuyuan. In Version 1.2 it was given free via the Summer Special Gift Pack, by mail, only to players who created a character before the version ended on 2026-08-19 05:59 (UTC+8). (It also appears in Version 1.4's City Tycoon Puka Membership Program.)
Hotori is 潯 in Traditional Chinese (浔 in Simplified). "Misty Tipsy Style" is 獨酌朧月流 (Simplified 独酌胧月流). Names follow the Taiwan service.

Her limited Arc is "Far Side of the Moon" (Celestial Special program, Tri-Keys or Celestial Keys). Outfit "Full Metal Rock" costs Riftcrystal x3,280 in the shop and is permanent; the discounted price x2,680 ended 2026-11-11 05:59 (UTC+8), so today it is 3,280.

Linko: Anima attribute, Plasma Arc type, S-Class limited; Ultimate is "Oversync". Not obtainable today (2026-11-18): her Board "Surfing All Channels!" last closed 2026-09-30 05:59 (UTC+8) and no rerun is listed (as of Version 1.5); her Arc "Voice of the Voyager" ran only in the same period.

When released in Version 1.2 it was a main story episode, told out of chronological order (a lighter chapter after the "Scarlet Letter" incident); Version 1.4 moved it to Spinoffs, so it is not part of the main story now. To unlock it: "Dreamwalk Corridor" completed and Hunter Lvl 26. It leads to the new location Warren Continent.
